descriptor.scope: 143 valid distinct JUPEM Penang cadastral-reference lots verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged George Town metropolitan WUP locator. The Forestry government GIS host supplies native UPI identity and FID transport IDs; variable-length native UPI strings are preserved without padding, truncation or substitution. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row geometry pages (56 parcels over 19 pages), all 143 fresh native-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 80 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32647 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The missing TLS intermediate is supplied from the official GlobalSign CA with certificate and hostname verification enabled for every runtime request; no runtime verification bypass is used. The publisher credits JUPEM 2020 and declares source CRS as ArcGIS WKID 102062; explicit EPSG:4326 output is retained unchanged. This is bounded metropolitan reference geometry, without claims of George Town municipal-only or citywide completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy or long-term key continuity.
